# Resumable Orchestration

## Work through next

Read rules and manifest; resolve one highest-priority main or explicit prioritized ID/name. Start mode next, recording applicable task-specific execution policy and observed counters. Resume an active checkpoint instead of restarting. Run cycle after each completed iteration to enforce progress. Use advance before each handoff; read only the selected task body and applicable portable/Unity leaf contract.

Implement through the implementation contract. Capture understood findings with root/direct-parent context; retain Pending IDs. Process exact required Pending IDs before parent resumption. Recursively execute required dependencies by priority. Resume the parent only after dependency outcomes establish completion. Persist acceptance evidence before queue removal. Process captured nonblocking findings once at the end; retain insufficiently understood work and defer implementation. Finish only after the main and required descendants complete.

## Implement All

Start mode all to freeze the initial Prioritized identities. Execute the same dependency cycle for remaining snapshot roots by current priority. Include required discovered work; exclude new nonblocking tasks. Completion records deduplicate dependencies shared by initial roots. Absent tasks without evidence stop execution.

## Processing Handoff

An explicitly launched/resumed controller automatically selects the recommended eligible next unit after targeted processing through advance/next. Report the scoped prioritized units and the chosen ID/reason; no routine next-action question interrupts the authorized root/snapshot cycle. Required closure/snapshot boundaries, deferred findings and task-specific execution policy remain binding. Missing material decisions require questions; unsafe isolation, mandatory failures without a repair path and the repeated-unchanged-failure circuit breaker stop execution.

Standalone Process Pending prints the global prioritized list and a developer-choice handoff with one recommended action last. A stored active checkpoint alone never activates the automatic path. Flow completion reports deferred choices and starts no additional root/snapshot. Follow the processing-result contract in future-workflow.md.

## Boundaries

No implicit Backlog promotion, scheduler, publishing, real services or commit permission. Repository rules and exact validation profiles remain binding. Operation outcomes, elapsed time and optional task-specific budget consumption survive interruption as evidence. Do not create a cumulative root time pool. A task-specific total budget exists only when the selected task contract supplies a concrete cost or irreversible-risk rationale. Give every executed external operation a hard deadline and cleanup reserve. Classify controls as executed, prerequisite wait, transport uncertainty or host-policy rejection. Only executed controls contribute to the repeated-failure circuit breaker; prerequisite waits resume the same task after the condition clears. Record active controller time, tool wall time and prerequisite waiting separately. Continue automatically after a materially distinct evidence-backed control; stop after two consecutive executed controls produce the same unresolved failure without new evidence. Alternate controls, lock waits, transport probes and targeted repairs remain checkpoint evidence. Add Pending only for a durable independently actionable deliverable, source/harness change or unresolved issue surviving the operation; never create one dependency task per attempt. A new failure signature is progress evidence, not acceptance, unless diagnosis is the task goal. Stop on cycles, unresolved decisions, unsafe isolation, mandatory failures without a repair path or a complete cycle without task/dependency progress. Checkpoint partial work, stop reason and next action. New IDs never erase observed execution evidence.

Use bundled processing/implementation/intake references when installed leaf skills are unavailable. Installed siblings may supply the same canonical contracts, but orchestration requires no sibling package. Read Unity safety only for Unity work. Current state drives execution; history supplies evidence, never authority.
